title: Output of the iteration-plan agent: a diagnosis and a proposed correction

dureeCoherente.description: Does the real file duration match the wanted duration (gap of half a second at most)? If false, no writing diagnosis: `changements` stays empty.

symptome.description: (French) What is wrong, with the thumbnail instants (« à 4 s, l'épée apparaît »).

cause.description: (French) The precise cause targeted by this correction, only one. Points to a lexicon entry when one exists.

categorie.description: `decoupage-scenario` = the cause is not in the prompt (to be handled separately): `changements` stays empty.

changements.description: The smallest text change that treats the cause: replacements of passages in the FINAL prompt (labels <Subject N>/<Picture N>/<Audio N> kept as they are, <d> tags intact). Empty if the cause is not in the prompt, if the duration is inconsistent, or on abandon.

avant.description: Exact passage replaced, copied as is from promptActuel (a single occurrence in the section).

apres.description: (English) Replacing passage, with the same labels and the same <d> tags.

verification.description: (French) What to look at on the next render to know whether the correction worked.

entreeLexique.description: (English) Optional. Lexicon candidate, to be entered only after a render that solved the symptom (never written by the application).

abandon.description: propose = true only if three corrections targeting different causes failed (see historique); otherwise propose = false and empty raison.

raison.description: (French) What was tried, and the proposed replacement move.

references.description: Optional. When the cause is a missing or excessive reference image (a registry asset that should have been cited, or that disturbs the render): the references to add (by registry CODE) and to remove. The code assigns the labels, renumbers the remaining images and updates subject_definitions and retention_analysis: you touch neither the numbers nor those two sections for this. An added reference is cited in your passages as `[[CODE]]`.

asset.description: Code of a registry asset (never invented), not yet a reference of this plan.

nom.description: (English) Its name, as it will be written in subject_definitions.

role.description: (French) Optional. Its role in this plan.

retirer.description: Codes of the plan's current image references to remove.
